title: Riddler conformance vector set
description: Byte-equality contract for Riddler signers: a language-agnostic runner re-signs each vector's inputs and asserts digest/signature/signed_object equality against the expected_* fields. See ../SPEC.md for the normative signing rules and ../README.md for the runner contract.

protocol.description: Which signing scheme this vector exercises.

chain.description: Source chain slug (e.g. "ethereum", "base"). null for xochi vectors, which carry chain ids inside eip712.message instead of a top-level chain key.

private_key.description: Canonical fixed test private key used to produce expected_signer/expected_signature. Never a real key.

expected_signer.description: Address recovered from expected_digest + expected_signature; must equal the address derived from private_key.

quote.description: erc3009/permit2 only: the quote-shaped payload (request/gasless) the signer consumes to build the EIP-712 message. See SPEC.md for the Quote shape.

domain.description: erc3009/permit2 only: the EIP-712 domain separator fields (name, version, chainId, verifyingContract).

message.description: erc3009/permit2 only: the EIP-712 message fields.

eip712.description: xochi only: the full { domain, types, message } EIP-712 payload. XochiIntent's domain intentionally omits verifyingContract (server-verified via ecrecover, not a contract).

expected_signed_object.description: erc3009/permit2 only: ABI-encoded calldata payload submitted alongside the signature. null for xochi (off-chain intent has no on-chain signed_object).
